title: aciviewmapper
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid.

createdon.description: Date and time when the display string was created.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the display string was last modified.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Unit Group.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the display string.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the displaystring.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the display string.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the displaystring.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization associated with the display string.
